utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It starts at 9 AM. Don't forget to bring your tools.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Hold on, Leo—are you sure this drive will actually solve the problem? I've seen too many quick fixes turn into bigger headaches.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It's a solid plan. We've got the right people and parts. Better than letting it fall apart.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I just hope we have enough spare parts for everything — supplies are running lower than I expected.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, maybe I can check with some of the other neighbors to see if they have spare parts lying around.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would be great, Jules — just make sure they know we can return anything we don't use.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hey Mara, I'm glad you're here—I wanted to check if you're available to help coordinate some volunteers for the repair drive this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, absolutely! I already told Dane we're meeting at my place at 9 AM Saturday—coffee's on me. How many volunteers are we expecting?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's wonderful, Mara! I think we're looking at about a dozen folks so far, but having you and Dane on board will make the morning run so smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So Oren, are we supposed to bring our own tools to this repair drive, or will they have everything we need?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Tools? Uli mentioned something about that... or was it Leo? I think I have a wrench somewhere in my garage, if I can remember where I put it!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So do we actually have a clear plan, or is this going to be like last time where we show up and nobody knows what they're doing?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Vik, I'm just picking up some flyers from Uli for the repair drive. Going to post them at the grocery store and library.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Ira, that's perfect! We're starting at 9 AM this Saturday, and we could use all the help we can get.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I'll make sure to mention the 9 AM start time when I put them up. See you there!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Tess, I've been thinking... could you maybe help with the repair drive? It would mean a lot.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course, Uli! I'd love to help out. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Just spread the word to anyone who might need something fixed... I'll handle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, really? I was hoping someone could tell me more—maybe I should ask around the block.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can fill you in on the details. I'm planning to be there right at 10 with my old lamp and toaster.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That's great timing—I've got a busted chair I'd love to bring if I knew where to go. Where exactly is it happening?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, Saturday morning east side works for me. Got it noted, gotta run.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Alright, catch you later, Bo—see you Saturday morning!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, see you Saturday—later, Gus.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I'm pretty sure it's about the heating system, but I can double-check with the organizers to confirm. Want me to do that?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, so it's a fix-it event! Count me in for Saturday, sounds like a good time.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, I think it's actually tomorrow, not Saturday. Let me check the start time for you.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Anyway, I should probably head back to my garage and double-check my inventory list before the drive starts.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, before you go, do you happen to know if the repair drive equipment is still parked near the old oak tree? I want to make sure I'm looking in the right spot.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, the repair drive supplies are still set up by the old oak tree. I made sure everything was secured there this morning.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: What do you think, Noah? Should we also reach out to the PTA to help spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the PTA? Um, yeah, sure, if you think it'll help... I'm a bit fuzzy on the details of this drive, honestly.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: No worries, Noah! It's a community tool and appliance repair drive — folks can bring broken items, and volunteers fix them for free. We're hoping to set up near the school pickup zone to make it easy for parents to join in.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh hey Sam! You're just the person I wanted to see—are you free this Saturday for the neighborhood repair drive? We're fixing up broken items together!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, I'm free Saturday! I can bring my toolbox and help with repairs or whatever else you need.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Sam! That's perfect—I'll add you to the volunteer list. Meet at the community center at 9 AM?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I'm almost done counting the spare parts, Tess—just need a few more hours to finish the list.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Well, you're a lifesaver, Cleo! Once you're done, we'll have the best-stocked repair drive this neighborhood has ever seen.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Tess! It's definitely a team effort—let's make sure everyone knows what we have so the drive goes smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Opal, I'm heading out to put up some flyers for the repair drive at the grocery store and library. Want to join me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, before we go, have you spotted the repair drive? I heard it's not by the oak tree anymore—Rosa mentioned it might be further down the street.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I hadn't heard that yet—thanks for the tip! I'll make sure the flyers point people to the right spot.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, do you know who's running it or not?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Honestly, I only know what I overhear from others. I haven't met whoever's organizing it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Well, if nobody's taking charge, how are we supposed to know what to do with our broken stuff?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Are you planning to bring anything to the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I was thinking of hauling over my spare wrenches and that old drill I fixed up—always good to put 'em to use.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That's great, Gus. That drill might come in handy for someone. What kind of repair are you most hoping to help with?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? We're getting everyone together to fix up old things around the neighborhood!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I... I know about it. I'm the one organizing it, actually.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, no kidding! That's awesome—you're the mastermind behind it! Well, I'm out here spreading the word like crazy, so tell me how I can help you pull this off!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I was just talking to Mara about timing the repair drive with school pickup. What do you think?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, I'm sticking to my plan to be there at 10 sharp. That should leave plenty of time before any school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure, 10 works for you, but if we shift it a bit later, we might get more parents who are already at the school for pickup.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sam! Right, the repair drive. I think I put a note on my fridge, but then I couldn't read my own writing... when is it again?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Oren, it's this Saturday from 9 to 3 at the community center. I'm helping Cleo sort supplies tomorrow—want to join us?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sort supplies tomorrow? I can do that, as long as you remind me on the day! I'll probably forget by then.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me double-check the time and details before I give you an answer.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, I appreciate you being thorough. Let's make sure we have a clear plan so nothing gets overlooked.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, exactly—I want to confirm both the starting time and whether tools are provided, since I remember Leo asking about it too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh hey Quinn, sorry I'm late—so we're fixing stuff together this weekend? Sounds cool, I've got a busted radio I've been meaning to look at.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Dane, just confirming—can you cover the east side tool pickup Saturday morning? I'm on the clock here.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure thing, Bo—I can grab the tools on the east side Saturday morning. That radio's not going anywhere.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Repair drive? I think I need some screws... or maybe bolts? Let me check my list... actually, I might have left it at home.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Noah, don't worry about the list—Vik's got everything organized. Just come by Saturday morning, I'm sure we can find what you need there!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Saturday? Oh, yeah, I think I can make it. What time are we starting?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, Dane! 9 AM at my place it is. See you then.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good, 9 AM at Mara's. I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, see you Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Rosa, you think this repair drive is actually gonna work? I've seen too many promises fall through.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Kira, I understand your doubts, but I've seen this community pull together before. If we each pitch in a little, even just with donations or a few hours of time, I really believe we can make a difference this time.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, Rosa, but how do I know this isn't just another feel-good project that fizzles out after a week?

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
